import pandas as pd

# Read sample 556 variant file
df = pd.read_excel('inputs/CHIP_DP10_GQ20_PASS/230209_Exome_GRCh38_CHIP_556-PF.xlsx', header=None)

# Data starts from row 2 (after two header rows)
data = df.iloc[2:].copy()
data.columns = ['Variant Info', 'Ref/Alt', 'Primary Findings', 'Incidental Findings', 
                'Zygosity', 'Mendel Error', 'Inherited From', 'Read Depths', 'Genotype Qualities', 
                'Variant Allele Freq', 'In ACMG SF Genes?', 'Match1', 
                'Gene Names', 'Sequence Ontology', 'Effect', 'Transcript', 
                'Exon', 'HGVS c.', 'HGVS p.', 'Filter', 'AF', 'AC', 'AN', 'Hom',
                'Variant ID', 'Classification', 'Interpretations', 'Review Status', 'Conditions',
                'In_CHIP', 'Match2', 'In_DNAm', 'Match3']

print('=== Zygosity distribution ===')
print(data['Zygosity'].value_counts())
print()

# Non-reference variants
nonref = data[data['Zygosity'] != 'Reference']
print(f'Total non-reference variants: {len(nonref)}')
print()

# Count by gene
gene_counts = nonref['Gene Names'].value_counts()
print('=== Gene counts (non-reference variants) ===')
print(gene_counts.to_string())
print()

# Top gene
top_gene = gene_counts.index[0]
top_count = gene_counts.iloc[0]
print(f'Gene with most non-reference variants: {top_gene} ({top_count})')
"
